name: Artificial Intelligence
short_description: Intelligent agents, uninformed/informed search, logic reasoning, and planning.
description: Foundations of classical AI covering rational agents, state-space search (A* search, minimax), knowledge representation, first-order logic, automated planning, and ethical considerations.

courses.title: AI Fundamentals
courses.description: State space exploration, heuristic search, logic, and intelligent agent environments.

modules.title: Introduction to AI
modules.description: History of AI, Turing test, strong vs weak AI, and agent architectures.

topics.title: Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
topics.summary: Rationality, Turing test, and AI winter cycles.

modules.title: Intelligent Agents
modules.description: PEAS framework (Performance, Environment, Actuators, Sensors) and agent types.

topics.title: PEAS Model & Agent Taxonomies
topics.summary: Simple reflex, model-based, goal-based, and utility-based agents.

modules.title: Search
modules.description: Uninformed search (BFS, DFS), informed heuristic search (A*, greedy best-first).

topics.title: Problem Formulation & Uninformed Search
topics.summary: State spaces, breadth-first, depth-first, uniform-cost, and iterative-deepening search.

topics.title: A* Search & Admissible Heuristics
topics.summary: Evaluation function f(n) = g(n) + h(n), consistency, and optimality proofs.

topics.title: Constraint Satisfaction Problems
topics.summary: Variables, domains, and constraints; backtracking with forward checking; arc consistency.

modules.title: Adversarial Search
modules.description: Planning against an opponent in two-player games.

topics.title: Minimax & Alpha-Beta Pruning
topics.summary: Game trees, the minimax value, and pruning branches that cannot matter.

modules.title: Knowledge Representation
modules.description: Ontologies, semantic networks, frames, and conceptual graphs.

topics.title: Ontologies & Semantic Frameworks
topics.summary: Structuring domain relationships and conceptual dependencies.

modules.title: Reasoning
modules.description: Propositional logic, first-order predicate calculus, resolution refutation.

topics.title: Propositional Logic & Inference
topics.summary: Syntax, truth tables, entailment, CNF, and resolution in propositional logic.

topics.title: First-Order Logic & Resolution
topics.summary: Unification, clausal normal form, and automated deduction.

modules.title: Reasoning Under Uncertainty
modules.description: Representing and reasoning with uncertain knowledge.

topics.title: Bayesian Networks & Probabilistic Inference
topics.summary: Conditional independence, network structure, and computing posteriors by enumeration.

modules.title: Planning
modules.description: Classical planning, STRIPS representation, and partial-order planning.

topics.title: STRIPS & Forward/Backward State Search
topics.summary: Preconditions, actions, add/delete lists, and goal state satisfaction.

modules.title: AI Ethics
modules.description: Algorithmic bias, transparency, explainability, safety, and alignment.

topics.title: Bias, Fairness & Explainability in AI
topics.summary: Auditing disparate impact, XAI interpretability, and alignment principles.
